summary: Executed backend non-GPU regression, frontend unit suites, and live UI integration against public URL. Core Nexus journey views/routes are present and mostly working; critical gaps remain in header notification action wiring and auth hardening controls.

critical.issue: No application auth httpOnly cookie is set on successful login (only edge cookie observed).
Brute-force lockout is not enforced; attempts 1-6 with invalid credentials all returned 401 without lockout/throttle response.
Responses return Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * while credentials are enabled, violating explicit-origin credentialed CORS requirement.

minor.endpoint: Live public API test calls during full pytest run
minor.issue: 2 tests hit transient ConnectTimeout on first run, both passed on immediate retry (flaky infra/network).

ui_bugs.issue: Notification bell trigger expected from source fragment (nexus-38) is missing in rendered header (avatar-only look), preventing direct held-work popup access path.

integration_issues.flow: Header notification -> open exact held record -> owner drawer
integration_issues.issue: Flow is blocked when bell trigger is absent; owner drawer cannot be reached from intended header popup path.

issues: No horizontal overflow detected, but 4 stat columns are visually dense; recommend minimal 2x2 layout within existing source component constraints.

action_items: Restore/wire original header actions slot so bell popup is visible and operational in My Work source shell.
Implement/enable auth lockout policy after 5 failed attempts (or equivalent rate-limit control with explicit refusal contract).
Fix credentialed CORS configuration to explicit allowed origins (no wildcard with credentials=true).
Decide and implement required login cookie strategy if playbook mandates httpOnly cookie-based session semantics.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth router currently returns token pair in body and does not set app-level auth cookies; aligns with token model but conflicts with requested playbook verification checks.
Demo identity seeder is insert-only/idempotent and does not update existing credentials; if 'seed_admin updates existing password' is still required, current behavior does not satisfy it.
Transient external URL timeouts occurred under full distributed run; isolate live-network dependent tests or add retry wrappers in CI to reduce false negatives.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Non-GPU suite run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported produced 707 tests total, 2 skipped, 2 transient timeout failures that passed on direct retry (flaky). Frontend unit suite passed (29/29). UI smoke confirms My Work/Board/Goals/GreyMirror/Watch routes and local-only New Task flow; primary unresolved blocker is missing header bell action path.
rca of the issue: RCA 1 (header actions gap): My Work shell renders top bar and avatar, but source bell action element [data-proto-line='nexus-38'] is absent; likely slot/gate mismatch in header action composition causing source popup path to be dropped. Repro: login operator -> /os/work/tasks?tab=records -> query selector [data-proto-line='nexus-38'] returns 0. Mitigation: rebind source header action fragment in active shell and verify View record opens owner drawer. RCA 2 (auth hardening): backend auth router issues bearer tokens only and contains no lockout/cookie emission path; CORS middleware emits wildcard origin while credentials allowed. Repro: 6 invalid logins all 401, login response lacks app auth Set-Cookie, response header includes wildcard origin. Mitigation: add lockout/throttle policy, align session transport expectations, and enforce explicit allowed origins when credentials are enabled.
